questions.q: Summarize what this report covers.

answer.text: This report covers the fiscal year that ended on 31 December 2025 for Northwind Instruments, which designs and manufactures industrial sensors, gateways, and measurement probes [p. 1](#page=1). The report includes sections on operations, financial results, quality, board decisions, sustainability, research and development, people, risk factors, products, glossary, and supplier performance [p. 1](#page=1). The financial results section details group revenue of USD 1,068.0 million, broken down by region [p. 4](#page=4). The quality section discusses warranty claims per quarter, noting a firmware issue in the gateway line that affected one quarter [p. 5](#page=5). The people section illustrates the workforce split across functions at year-end [p. 10](#page=10).

questions.q: Tóm tắt các nội dung chính của báo cáo.

answer.text:
The report presents Sao Mai's financial results for the year ending December 31, 2025 [p. 1](#page=1). It covers shareholder letters, production activities, business results, human resources, production volume, dividends, investment plans, raw material prices, sustainable development, and plans for 2026 [p. 1](#page=1).

Key business results show revenue by business segment in billions of VND: Food at 1,120 with 8.5% growth, Beverages at 870 with 15.2% growth, and Packaging at 460 with -3.1% growth [p. 4](#page=4).

Production volume varies seasonally throughout the year, with Figure 2 illustrating the volume for each quarter in 2025 (in tons) [p. 6](#page=6). The quarterly production figures are: Q1 at 5,200 tons, Q2 at 6,100 tons, Q3 at 7,450 tons, and Q4 at 6,800 tons [p. 6](#page=6).

Sao Mai plans to increase the capacity of the Binh Duong factory and expand cold storage, with the project requiring 120 billion VND annually [p. 8](#page=8). In 2025, water consumption per ton of product decreased by 18% compared to 2023, and all paper packaging was collected and recycled [p. 10](#page=10).

questions.q: Give me a short overview of this manual.

answer.text: This manual provides information about the Aurora X3 Air Purifier, including its specifications, troubleshooting tips, warranty details, and contact information [p. 1](#page=1), [p. 5](#page=5), [p. 4](#page=4), [p. 6](#page=6). The specifications include a clean air delivery rate of 320 m³/h, a noise level of 24 dB in sleep mode, and a power consumption of 45 W [p. 2](#page=2). Troubleshooting common errors like E2 (filter not seated correctly) and E5 (fan blocked) is also covered [p. 4](#page=4). The product comes with a 2-year warranty, excluding filters [p. 5](#page=5). Customer care is available via phone from Monday to Saturday [p. 6](#page=6).
